facts.business: Reliance Power Limited is engaged in power generation through its subsidiaries, including coal-based, gas-based, solar, wind, and hydro projects, and is developing renewable energy projects with battery storage.

750 MW FDRE + 3,000 MWh BESS (Reliance NU Energies)
500 MWp solar + 770 MW hydro (Bhutan partnership via REPL)

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: (a) ED proceedings under PMLA regarding fake bank guarantee to SECI, arrest of former ED & CFO; (b) ED search and provisional attachment of assets of Company and RNRL; (c) Material uncertainty related to going concern due to corporate guarantee invocation by SMPL and CIRP initiation by SMPL's lender.
